note: Written by reference/ledgerd-client/scripts/gen-outlook-sender-conformance.ts from the TypeScript oracle (analyzeOutlookSender in src/mail/authres.ts); do not hand-edit. Each vector is one header block (`headers`, or `headers_parts`: concatenate each part's `text` repeated `repeat` times) and whether Graph put the message in the Inbox (`in_inbox`). Every vector uses the document's `known_senders` and `reject_domains`. All inputs are synthetic. See README.md.
